cues.text: automated online sampling with flex to
an Amber 15 cell culture system bio
profile flex 2 is a comprehensive
automated 16 test cell culture analyser
flex 2 analyzes chemistry's pH and gases
cell density and cell viability and
osmolality in a modular platform flex
2's low maintenance design fast analysis
time and low sample volume provide
maximum workflow efficiency flex 2
offers 4 unique sampling options
including single sampling external load
and go tray sampling 96-well microtiter
tray sampling and automated online
sampling flex 2 is the only cell culture
analyzer designed for automated online
sampling of large-scale production
bioreactors to micro scale bioreactors
including the amber 15 and amber 250
cell culture platforms automated
sampling is made possible with the
optional external sampling module or ESM
this small liquid handling device
automatically delivers cell culture
samples from amber 15 micro bio reactor
systems to flex to for analysis at just
8 inches wide the ESM requires very
little additional bench space the ESM
snap-in reagent packs support up to 240
samples and are replaceable in seconds
sample scheduling and test configuration
are performed via the amber 15 user
interface new process steps can be
created or existing process steps
modified to schedule sampling of each
micro bioreactor followed by analysis by
the Flex to process step configuration
includes sample scheduling selection of
the sample type which defines the test
venue cell inspection settings onboard
delusions key parameters and parameter
offs
as well as pH trigger points and offset
limits and deprotonation steps following
analysis amber software allows users to
check for sufficient flex to reagents to
ensure all scheduled testing can be
completed for up to four days of
scheduled samples if reagents will be
depleted or expired within the desired
period amber software will provide a
warning reminding users that replacement
of reagents will be necessary in order
to complete all scheduled analysis steps
key parameters can be defined in the
Flex - user interface and testing
proceeds only when all key parameters
are available preserving sample volume
when scheduled a sample is aspirated
from an Amber Micro bioreactor and
dispensed into the custom acrylic cup on
the amber deck flex 2 retrieves the
sample from the cup for analysis the
Flex 2 system probe distributes the
sample to the appropriate modules for
analysis following analysis the
remaining sample is dispensed into
sealed waste bags within the ESM's
reagent pack cleaning and deprotonating
solutions contained within the reagent
pack also ensure that fluid lines are
cleaned between samples preventing
biological build-up and eliminating
sample to sample carryover when the
analysis is completed flex to
immediately transmits all data to the
amber 15 software flex 2 data is
displayed on all relevant amber graphs
algorithms utilizing one or any
combination of up to 16 tests measured
on flex 2 can be defined on the amber 15
software for feedback control the cycle
time of the integrated system including
sampling and testing is 6 to 7 minutes
depending on the configuration of tests
selected volume preservation is critical
for small
volume culture systems the maximum
volume taken from each micro bioreactor
is 400 to 500 microliters in most cases
this enables daily sampling of each
micro bioreactor while providing results
for all measured tests including pH
gases chemistry's cell density and
viability and osmolality flex twos
integration with Amber 15 allows for
unprecedented automation however flex 2
can also be used for single sampling and
tray sampling when not processing amber
samples flex 2 is the industry's only
comprehensive 16 test cell culture
analyzer with automated sampling from
amber cell culture systems flex 2's high
capacity reagents provide walkaway
automated analysis for more than one
week flex 2's low sample volumes enable
daily sampling of amber 15 cell culture
systems while providing an instrument
that is very easy to maintain an
extremely robust flex 2 enables
customized feedback control for all
measured tests with infinite
possibilities for the most advanced
process control strategies
